title: Midnight Turkish Flatbread with Bottarga
description: A simple yet flavorful snack inspired by Turkish cuisine, featuring the salty, savory taste of bottarga.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine intense flour, midnight salt, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add in water to form a dough. Knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions. Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
Brush the flatbreads with turkish olive oil and bake in the oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the flatbreads from the oven and top each with a slice of bottarga.
Return the flatbreads to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes or until the bottarga is warm and slightly caramelized.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately.
